formula: It was only after + X + that + complete clause

formulas.formula: It was only after + X + that + complete clause

example: It was only after I moved out that I learned how much my parents had done for me.
exampleZh: 直到我搬出去住之後，我才明白父母為我付出了多少。

examples.en: It was only after I moved out that I learned how much my parents had done for me.
examples.zh: 直到我搬出去住之後，我才明白父母為我付出了多少。
examples.highlight: It was only after I moved out that I learned how much my parents had done for me.

rules.zh: 在 It was only after X that Y 結構中，that 子句使用正常陳述句語序，即主語在前、動詞在後；不可在 that 後使用疑問句倒裝。
rules.en: Do Not Use Inversion after “that” It was only after the meeting that I understood the problem. It was only after the meeting that did I understand the problem. subject + verb that I realised that she understood that they changed the policy

rules.zh: 以下句子同樣正確：【Only after the meeting did I understand the problem.】 直到會議結束後，我才明白問題所在。 但是它使用另一個句型：【Only after X + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb】 比較：【It was only after the meeting that I understood the problem.】 本練習的目標是第一種：【It was only after X that Y.】
rules.en: The Inverted Alternative Is a Different Structure Only after the meeting did I understand the problem. Only after X + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb It was only after the meeting that I understood the problem. Only after the meeting did I understand the problem. It was only after X that Y.

rules.zh: 比較：【It was after the meeting that I understood the problem.】 我是在會議結束後明白問題的。 直到會議結束後，我才明白問題。 加入 only 後，句子表示：在會議結束之前，我一直未能明白。
rules.en: “Only” Is Essential It was after the meeting that I understood the problem. It was only after the meeting that I understood the problem.

rules.zh: 這句在文法上會令人以為 the medicine 與醫生說話。較清楚的版本是：【It was only after the patient spoke to the doctor that the medicine was changed.】 直到病人與醫生交談後，藥物才被更換。
rules.en: Check the Subject of an -ing Phrase It was only after speaking to the doctor that Emma felt less worried. Emma spoke to the doctor. Emma felt less worried. Incorrect or illogical: It was only after speaking to the doctor that the medicine was changed. It was only after the patient spoke to the doctor that the medicine was changed.

rules.zh: 這個句型常用於描述：後來才明白的道理；過了一段時間才注意到的問題；經歷某件事後才改變的看法；某個條件完成後才出現的行動；一個令事情改變的關鍵時刻。
rules.en: The Structure Usually Shows a Turning Point

benefits.zh: 清楚指出事情的轉捩點這個句型能清楚告訴讀者，哪一件事令後來的理解、決定或行動出現。直到遺失錢包後，本才開始減少攜帶現金。 讀者可以立即看到：轉捩點：losing his wallet 後來的改變：started carrying less cash
benefits.en: It Makes the Turning Point Clear This structure tells the reader exactly which event caused a later realisation, decision or action. It was only after losing his wallet that Ben started carrying less cash.

benefits.zh: 強調某件事到很後期才發生普通的 after 句只交代事情的先後次序。還會強調某件事遲遲未有發生。我在會議後明白了問題。 直到會議結束後，我才明白問題。 第二句更能表達「在此之前一直不明白」。
benefits.en: It Emphasises That Something Happened Late A simple after-sentence only gives the order of events. It was only after…that… also emphasises the delay. It was only after…that… Compare: I understood the problem after the meeting. It was only after the meeting that I understood the problem.

benefits.zh: 把「之前未發生」和「後來才發生」合併起來你不需要用兩句分別解釋事情前後的變化，也可以在一句內完整表達。
benefits.en: It Combines the “Before” and “After” Ideas Instead of explaining the timeline in two sentences, you can present the whole change in one sentence. Longer: Before I joined the company, I did not understand how difficult the job was. After I joined, I understood it. More organised: It was only after joining the company that I understood how difficult the job was.

benefits.zh: 適合反思及個人經歷寫作這個句型特別適合用來描述：後來學到的道理；個人成長；從錯誤中得到的教訓；看法的改變；重要經歷。直到我搬出去住之後，我才明白父母為我付出了多少。
benefits.en: It Is Useful for Reflective Writing This structure is especially useful when writing about: lessons learned personal growth mistakes changes of opinion important experiences. It was only after I moved out that I learned how much my parents had done for me.

benefits.zh: 增加句式變化學生經常重複使用：【I did not realise…until…；After…, I…；Then I…；I finally realised…】 目標表達【It was only after…that…】能提供另一種組織句子的方法，令寫作不會過於重複。
benefits.en: It Adds Sentence Variety Students often repeatedly use: I did not realise…until… After…, I… Then I… I finally realised… It was only after…that… gives you another way to organise the same idea. I finally realised… It was only after…that…
